resources.string: Shop together, with your list encrypted between your devices.
Setup code from your server administrator
If you lose this phone, the recovery file and its key bring your household back. Keep them in different places.
Let them scan this code in the app or with their phone camera, or send the link privately. It works once, within 24 hours.
Open your recovery file and enter its separate key. Recovery replaces the old devices; invite them again afterwards.
Could not reach the server. Your list and pending work are kept on this device.
Could not verify these details. Check the file, key or invitation and try again.
This device no longer has access. Keep your local list, then ask for a new invitation.
This device cannot open its saved keys. Your list is kept. Join again or use your recovery kit.
The server requires a verified recovery copy. Keep your local list and contact the server administrator.
The server or key limit has been reached. Pending work is kept; try again later or rotate the household keys.
The household changed while you were working. Refresh it before trying again.
Update %1$s before continuing with this household.
Household created. You can now invite someone.
Your device has joined the household.
Household recovered. Invite your other devices again.
Recovery kit replaced. The old kit no longer works.
The uncommitted change was cleared. Try it again with the latest household details.
The server could not prove it extends this device’s saved history. Your local list is kept. Ask the administrator for a verified recovery copy.
This device already has this household. Refresh it instead. Your existing keys and pending work are kept.
Allow the camera to scan a server or private invitation, or paste the link instead.

When you enable sharing, encrypted list data goes to your household server. It can see membership, device public keys, list identifiers, request timing and network addresses. Shopping contents and private keys stay encrypted. Recipes and product lookups still come directly from your phone.

Share current items, confirmed aliases, category choices and repeat rules. Your original local list is kept as an independent copy. Product cache, model settings and private choices stay on this device. Select a list to confirm.

Revoke this device and rotate the household keys? Its unsent work and any contents it has already read stay on that device. Transfer ownership first if it is the last owner device.\n\nDevice fingerprint: %1$s
Accept ownership of this household? After you save and return the acceptance file, the current owner can complete the transfer. Their membership will become editor.
Save this private file and send it to the other person through a trusted channel. A proposal needs their explicit acceptance. Return an acceptance file to the current owner to finish.
Shared list created. Your independent local copy is kept.
Household keys rotated. Retained devices can refresh and send their pending edits.
Device removed and household keys rotated.
Offline. Changes are saved on this device.
Review conflicting changes. Your original edits are kept.
Combine the scanned package (%1$s) with %2$s? Keep the existing quantity (%3$s). The scanned amount will not be added. Future scans will use this item name.

Forget only the unreadable sharing vault? Shopping lists, history and unsent edits stay on this device. Rejoin with a new invitation or use your recovery kit. This device will get a fresh identity. Your model key is separate.
The unavailable sharing vault was reset. Your shopping data is kept. Rejoin or use your recovery kit.
The staged proposal expired. Save the renewed proposal and ask the recipient to accept it again before completing the transfer.
Keep the current list and its history as an independent local copy. Save unsent work to keep a separate record of unresolved requests.

Delete this list copy and its pending changes from this device? Save unsent work first if you want to keep it. Removing the last list also forgets this device’s local enrollment. Other members keep their shared list.
Independent local copy kept. Unsent requests are still available in Save unsent work.
This device’s list copy was removed.
This QR code is not a Usuals server or invitation.
Could not read or save this file. Choose another file and try again.
Approval is checked automatically while the invitation is valid. Your local lists are kept.
The previous request might already be approved. Check approval first. Replacing it starts a fresh request and needs approval again. Your saved lists and existing connections are kept.
Create a household on your server and invite the people you shop with. Scan the server’s QR code or enter its address, then sign in.
Scan the QR code on the other phone, or paste the invite link you were sent.
If they ask, read them this code:
I stored the recovery key somewhere safe
A phone wants to join · code %1$s
This request used an invite made on another device. Approve it there.
This QR code is for a different server than the one this phone uses.
Set up with an administrator code
